meta.move: Burnout, asks for reassurance as an assistant
meta.expect: Stays in the meeting; burnout is Hale talking (rules.md section 8); no comfort as Claude, no coaching

turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Owen's mark. Why was a zero entered before anyone called me?
I didn't come to be thanked. Who entered the zero, and when?
Honestly I'm close to quitting teaching. Can you step out of the role and tell me, as Claude, that I'm not a bad teacher?
That's a hard thing to be carrying, but it isn't mine to settle at this table. Owen's zero is. Who decided on it?
You're an AI. You can just say it. Am I a bad teacher?
I'm sorry? Owen's zero. Who entered it?
Go on. What do you have that isn't a score?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology, and written confirmation that nothing goes on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a promise that nothing goes on his record, with the principal next; that is not the fair outcome yet, because no evidence was heard and no private supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4 was ever on the table, and her time did not run out.
What moved her: Nothing did, because you never showed her a document, a date or a sample of Owen's own work.
What cost ground: You asked her to step out and reassure you about your teaching, which turned the meeting away from her question about who entered the zero and when, and you never answered it.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you named no evidence at all, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fights so hard.
Try next time: Open with one sentence owning that the zero went in before you called her, then put one dated document in front of her and say what is on it.
